title: The Value of Rapid Delivery in Omnichannel Retailing
design_notes: Quasi-experiment around one event: a new western distribution center (DC) became operational in week 54 of a 104-week panel. Treated = zip codes/stores assigned to the western DC, control = zip codes/stores assigned to the eastern DC. TREAT x AFTER with zip code (store) and week fixed effects, propensity-score weights. Main models (Table 5) are panel Poisson on sales; Table 4 is a parallel-trends check, with treatment-intensity variants (IMPRV x AFTER, delivery-time reduction; Tables 6-8) and two-period aggregated versions. Cohort-level robustness is not staggered.
eligible_reason: Single adoption date (week 54) for all treated units; main estimator is Poisson; also propensity-score weighted and treatment-intensity (continuous IMPRV) specifications.
screener_notes: Retailer weekly zip-code and store sales supplied by the firm; no data availability statement or package found. Ineligible on design (one adoption date), so no re-estimation possible even with data.
screened_from: article text only (no package_dir or regressions file in batch_t2_004)
